findings.detail: The candidate ran successful installation before the invalid copy in another database in the same cluster. Accepted roles are cluster-wide, so they would already survive and duplicate CREATE ROLE would preempt the intended rollback proof.
The candidate paired --single-transaction with plain implicit stdin even though PostgreSQL 16 permits that option only with one or more -c/-f inputs.

recovery: Run the invalid copy first while roles are absent, prove database-local fabric and cluster-wide role absence, then run success; bind every artifact stream to --file=- plus --single-transaction and ON_ERROR_STOP=1.
